svg.title: World map — Gall–Peters projection
svg.desc: A text-free Gall–Peters equal-area transformation of world.svg. It preserves the simplified geography, perceptually separated light country colours, white gaps, light blue water, and white Antarctica from world.svg.
svg.metadata: Projected derivative of world.svg. The Peirce implementation follows d3-geo-projection; source geography derives from Mercator Projection.svg by Geordie Bosanko, CC BY-SA 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mercator_Projection.svg.
